officialText:
It shall be unlawful to perform manual welding work on any structural member of any building unless such work is performed by a person licensed as a welder under the provisions of this article.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
